# TASK-080 — specification

## Scope

Run the CI locally with act: `.actrc`, `.act/secrets.example`, `.act/vars.example`, `pnpm ci:local` / `ci:local:list` / `ci:local:all`, guide in `docs/ci-local.md`. The workflow adapts through `env.ACT` and `vars.ACT_POSTGRES_PORT` (PostgreSQL service port, gitleaks without a token, no GHA cache). Fixed two workflow bugs found this way: a step `if` reading `secrets` (invalid on GitHub too) and the fixed service port.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Run the CI workflow locally in Docker with act, documented in `docs/ci-local.md`.
